name: Spatial Tour
summary:
Spatial Tour brings real estate to life in fully immersive virtual reality. Step inside any property and explore it as if you were really there — in stunning 8K stereoscopic 360°, with true sense of depth, scale, and space that flat photos and video simply can't capture.

Move through homes and developments room by room using your controller. Look up at soaring ceilings, take in a view from the balcony, and get a genuine feel for the flow and dimensions of every space — all from the comfort of your headset.
